records.title: Aero-embolism: letter from Eugene B. Ferris to J. F. Fulton, 4 July 1942
records.locator: Letter heading printed p. 52 (PDF p. 50) and results printed p. 53 (PDF p. 51)
records.note: Preliminary investigator letter. Nine people had source-defined bends within 45 minutes at 35,000 ft without prebreathe. Four delayed local-pain observations have no verified follow-up denominator.

records.title: Preselection tests
records.locator: Chapter X, printed pp. 331, 336 (PDF pp. 366, 371), Table 74 and Figure 73
records.note: Page 331 supplies six published validation percentages. Table 74 reproduces approximate first-test classification margins for Halifax and Cincinnati. The model uses exact counts from the earlier investigators' tables for those margins.
